description: This Science Data Bank deposit contains labelled high-resolution UAV imagery of floods and waterlogging in Jiujiang, Jiangxi Province. The producing institutes provide 412 original image and annotation pairs as JPG and PNG, plus 12,080 non-overlapping 512-by-512-pixel cropped samples. Text files name the training, validation and test samples in an 8:1:1 split. The named repository page is public under CC BY 4.0. A modeller could use the labels to train or check flood-extent extraction from UAV imagery, then compare mapped inundation with urban drainage or exposure simulations. The deposit is an image benchmark, not a time series of rainfall, flood depth or drainage-network operation. The page does not state ground sampling distance or event dates in the inspected metadata, so these remain unknown here. The split has not been checked for spatial leakage between adjacent crops. Images were not downloaded or modelled. No directly related catalogue record was found in the full identity scan.
